# Printed Text

Height of embossed or depth of engraved lettering; also warns of small characters.

<figure markdown="span">
![Printed Text: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-printed-text-depth-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Printed Text: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-printed-text-depth-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>How far printed lettering stands out from, or is cut into, the surface.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [FDM](../../reference/processes/fdm-3d-printing.md) | Low |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](../../reference/processes/resin-3d-printing.md) | Low |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | Low |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At least** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

=== "FDM"

    Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 0.5 mm | 0.3 mm | Not yet sourced |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, PLA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU (Flexible), PA, PA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PC.


=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 0.5 mm | 0.15 mm | Aim for: Published, [HLH Prototypes](../../citations/bibliography.md#hlh-sla "0.5 mm deep engraving")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 4: 0.15 mm engraved detail (0.1 mm embossed)") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: Standard Resin, Tough / Durable Resin, Flexible / Elastic Resin.


=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 1.0 mm | 0.3 mm | Aim for: Published, [HP](../../citations/bibliography.md#hp-mjf "At least 1 mm deep or high")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-fuse "0.3 mm font depth") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA12 (MJF), PA11, PA12 Carbon-filled, TPU.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "FDM"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Shallow printed text (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Letters this shallow are only a layer or two and read poorly.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Printed text too shallow (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under `{limit}`. The lettering may not show at all at normal layer heights. Raise it or cut it in by at least `{target}`.

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Shallow printed text (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}`. It may read poorly. Raise it or cut it in by about `{target}`.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Printed text too shallow (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under `{limit}`. Raised detail this low may not show, and cut-in detail may fill in. Raise it or cut it in by at least `{target}`.

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Shallow printed text (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Shallow lettering is worn away by bead blasting and lost in the grainy surface. Raise it or cut it in by about `{target}`.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Printed text too shallow (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under `{limit}`. It may not show after cleaning. Raise it or cut it in by at least `{target}`.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At least" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
| `{relief}` | "height" (raised text) or "depth" (cut-in text) |
